definition: Affix means to attach something. Some common uses of the term “affix” in a legal sense include:  In the context of real estate, the term “affix” means to attach something to real estate in a permanent way. For example, planting trees or constructing a building on real estate property.  Affixed items are permanent and cannot be picked up and moved away. affirmative defense / affix Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026  Affix may also be used to refer to the act of signing or sealing a document.
